request.purpose: Our client launches a new drug for this condition. We want to focus our physician advertising campaign on the regions where it is most common.
request.question: How many patients have the type 2 diabetes code E11.6x (with complications), by region?
definitions: Complicated type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.6.
Report per region: patients with complicated type 2 diabetes.
